title: BranchManagementSettings - Metadata API
description: Represents the branch management settings for an org. This type extends the Metadata metadata type and inherits its fullName field.

associateAccountWithBranch.description: Automatically associates new accounts with the user’s current branch by creating branch unit customer records. The default value is false.
